note: Provenance pin for the portal-surfaces feed (issue #350), served live by this repo's portal serving layer at GET /api/portal/surfaces (feature-flag surfaces.portal_surfaces, ON by default per the policy-gr5-enabled-by-default reversal - infra/feature-flags/registry.yaml). The `generated_from`, `surfaces` and `gaps` fields are copied VERBATIM from kushin77/CMR `catalog/portal-surfaces.json` at the revision recorded above; `pin` and `note` are this repo's provenance record. The upstream blob was fetched with `gh api -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' 'repos/kushin77/CMR/contents/catalog/portal-surfaces.json?ref=<revision>'` and its sha256 recorded in pin.sha256, so the copy is auditable. Refresh = re-fetch that path at a newer revision, re-record revision/retrievedAt/sha256/bytes, re-copy the three verbatim fields - never hand-edit surfaces[]. While the pin cannot be read the server answers an explicitly `unresolved` document with an empty surfaces list; no surface is invented here. kushin77/CMR#708 (which this issue was blocked on) closed 2026-09-11 with the artifact published; the consuming shell (kushin77/shared-frontend) still reads its OWN registry/portal-surfaces.pinned.json - adopting this feed there is shell-side work.

features.desc: Producer spine: per-language SCIP/ctags indexers, ingest into index.db, atomic publish, --allow-partial policy
TypeScript/JavaScript semantic indexer (scip-typescript)
Python semantic indexer (scip-python)
Go semantic indexer (scip-go)
Java semantic indexer (scip-java; Kotlin* and Scala* conditional)
Rust semantic indexer (scip-rust)
Bash/shell/config lexical indexer (universal-ctags); definitions only, references unresolvable
CLI query surface: def/refs/search/repos/runs/changed (pyproject extras: core)
HTTP API surface (codeidx.api via uvicorn; pyproject extras: api)
Web UI served by the HTTP API (ships in the codeidx package)
MCP server surface (codeidx.mcp_server; .mcp.json / scripts/codeidx-mcp; pyproject extras: mcp)
LSP surface (codeidx.lsp_server via pygls; pyproject extras: lsp)
Publish gate: refuses to index/publish credential material (codeidx.secret_scan, scripts/prescan-credentials.py)
GCP org/folder/project/resource extraction via the Cloud Asset API with PostgreSQL persistence (cloud_asset_api/extractors.py's OrgExtractor, cloud_asset_api/persistence.py).
Architecture diagram generation from extracted/topology data via Graphviz, plus Mermaid import and diagrams.net/drawio (mxGraph) export (cloud_asset_api/diagram_generators.py).

Reverse-direction codegen: parses a saved drawio diagram whose shapes are tagged with resourceType custom properties and generates real Terraform HCL from it (cloud_asset_api/blueprint_engine.py, kushin77/diagrams#147).

Deterministic diffing of live extracted state vs. Terraform-declared state (declared-but-missing, live-but-undeclared, or mismatched-attribute), surfaced as Findings (cloud_asset_api/drift.py, kushin77/diagrams#148).
Renders a diagram preview from a Terraform plan's proposed changes before anyone runs `terraform apply` (cloud_asset_api/plan_preview.py, POST /api/diagrams/plan_preview).

Generalized node/edge dependency-graph model plus overlay rendering (cost, health, severity, drift status), used across the extraction-to-diagram feature set (cloud_asset_api/topology.py, kushin77/diagrams#176).
Flask REST API plus authenticated WebSocket updates, OAuth-gated with RBAC, with an OpenAPI spec (cloud_asset_api/api.py, cloud_asset_api/openapi_spec.py).
React web portal (web_ui/) for hierarchy, diagrams, the drawio-based editor, findings, catalog, and admin views, served behind the auth-hub.purebliss.app SSO relay.

Pluggable adapter framework for extracting real resources from AWS, Azure, GCP (incl. billing), GitHub, GitHub Actions, Google Workspace, GoHighLevel, Kubernetes, Datadog, OCI, on-prem (Docker), PostgreSQL, and Terraform state (cloud_asset_api/vendors/).

Deterministic, no-LLM-judgment checks (post-deploy health, dependency CVE scan-and-report, etc.) run on a timer or on demand, reported via a durable local log and optional webhook/Findings API (mechanical/).

The diagrams-kb MCP server (kb://<topic>, kb_search) registered in this repo's own root .mcp.json is repo-local dev tooling for sessions working in this repo, not an org-wide consumable surface -- left default off pending any future CMR-governed decision to expose it more broadly.
Workspace Control Center CardService add-on (Gmail/Drive/Docs/Sheets contexts)
Dispatch API + action registry + job runner (Cloud Run)
Joiner/mover/leaver provisioning (users, OUs, groups, Drive transfer)
Directory groups -> saas-rbac role bindings
Declarative cross-suite recipes (when X do Y, dry-run first)
Audit capture on every admin/domain operation (invariant)
Gmail/Calendar watch -> Pub/Sub -> Cloud Tasks pipeline
Read-only live workspace data API (directory/groups/calendar summary) with audit + least-privilege scopes
Module-manifest dependency closure, cycle detection, reverse-dependents, transitive deps (extracted from fleet/pmo.sh deps)
Risk/Assumption/Issue/Dependency register with SLA-aging tiers (extracted from fleet/pmo.sh raid + aging)
Cross-repo status/program rollup reporting (extracted from fleet/pmo.sh report)
P0/BAU/project priority normalization across heterogeneous per-repo vocabularies (channels/priority-map.tsv pattern)
Deterministic program-intake scoring + routing (extracted from fleet/pmo.sh intake, DR-038)

Secondary visualization layer: sync GitHub Projects data into an OpenProject view. GitHub Projects stays the system of record; this is read-only visualization, never a competing tracker. Not yet implemented (see kushin77/pmo issue: PMO dashboard sync).

Single-chrome OS portal: AppShell sidebar/topbar/bottom-tab, Desktop tiles, portal switcher, Settings→Clients, ErrorBoundary + load lifecycle, os.activeModule persist/restore. Registry portal entry in registry/modules.json is the surface.
ADR-0007 native addons: addons/<id>/ React component lazy-loaded into the OS shell (OsModuleContext/useOsModule, addonNav body-only rendering). Mount.type=native + mount.entry in the registry.
modules/schema.json (ModuleMount native|iframe|tab, enabled) + registry/modules.json + verify-registry.js — the machine-readable module contract consumers register against.
shared/design-tokens twin (tokens.json ⇄ tokens.css, --os-* namespace) with verify-design-tokens.js parity gate — provenance-grounded palette shared with consumers.
templates/diagrams-layout reusable chrome + lib/osBridge.js + scripts/template-scaffold.sh (`NAME=<id> make template`) — one-command scaffolder for consumer frontends.
Sandboxed-iframe fallback mount (ADR-0001) + typed os:* postMessage envelope (shell/src/bridge.ts: os-module:ready/os:session/os:theme/os:navigate) + contrib/portal-snippet.js drop-in.

Google OAuth gate (shared auth-hub relay) → short-lived RS256 os-session-token minted by /auth/me, JWKS at /auth/.well-known/jwks.json, /auth/verify for consumer backends, multi-key rotation, no-cache SPA serving.
Vendor/sync tooling (scripts/vendor-sync.sh, vendor-drift-check.sh, verify-vendor-deploy.sh, addon provenance). Default off — consumers do not need upstream sync to consume the engine.
